newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers listless with poor enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers listless with poor enquiries.

text.p: The Singapore bunker market was listless on Monday with very few enquiries and tradres expected the market to remain dull as Japanese traders are still out due to the golden week holidays.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted by majors at $105 per tonne and the 380-cst was at about $99. Quotes from independents were about $1-$2 per tonne lower.
"Prices in other ports are quite competitive at the moment so shipowners just stay away from Singapore," said one trader.
MDO and gas oil were quoted at about $193/$195 and $205/$208. -- Singapore Newsroom (65 8703571)
